summary: Build a visual language from a small vocabulary of geometric relationships with an explicit distinction between metaphor and measured quantities.
objective: Viewers can distinguish a decorative relationship from a labeled data mapping, and overlapping forms do not hide the main structure.
intent_signals: Compose a visual language from repeated shapes
example_prompts: Create a geometric-abstract sculpture of an agent network with an explicit legend for each shape.

principles: Build a visual language from a small vocabulary of geometric relationships with an explicit distinction between metaphor and measured quantities.
This is an authored creative proposal, not a historical definition, fixed template or required rendering library.
implementation: Repeat and vary primitives through scale, interval and orientation; when shapes encode entities, keep identity stable across views.
Use material and light contrast to separate groups rather than adding ornamental texture to every primitive.
Offer a view that reveals the organizing relation; animate transformations or group movement with clear state ownership.
observable_checks: Viewers can distinguish a decorative relationship from a labeled data mapping, and overlapping forms do not hide the main structure.
Inspect the selected view and an alternate view at the intended output size before accepting the treatment.

known_limits: Proposed art direction only; no rendered artifact, runtime improvement or perceptual validation has been observed for this record.
Appearance choices do not certify factual geometry, material measurements or simulated behavior.
creative_affordances: Combine with generative rules or monochrome study; geometry used as metaphor does not become proof of a mathematical claim.
